name: THE STOVE MAN
note: A STORY ANCHOR, not a fourth drinker: the man who has not taken his coat off since Thad arrived in this territory. RESTAGED after the first composition put him at 1150,570 -- out in open floor between the card table and the bar, reading as a man standing in the middle of the room, which is the one thing he must not read as. The stove's own base line is y 412, which is 94 px BEHIND the walkable floor's far edge, so nobody can stand level with it; he now stands at the floor's far edge at 1150,508, just off the stove's right side and overlapping it, which is where a man warming himself actually stands -- in front of the iron, not beside it.
poseNote: standing to the right of the stove, coat on, turned toward the iron

sprite.note: PHASE 2A: one frame, and that is the phase, not an omission. Static staging first, and Tyler accepts the face in the room before any life is animated on it -- doc 36 Q128. The sheet is pre-scaled to the height this room asks for where the character stands, so the engine draws it at about 1:1 instead of shrinking a 1200 px painting on every frame.

barksNote: NONE. These nine are the room's population, not its dialogue: doc 07's reputation barks belong to the named ambient cast, and nothing in Tyler's Phase 2A ruling gives a generic patron a line. No written content is invented for them here or anywhere.
